answer: Registration locks a dual-asset bond, half token and half stablecoin as a slashable bond: an identity costs real money. The yarrow is where slashable funds wait for a verdict. A farm needs a fresh onyx per fake, each costing a full bond. Without a river of fresh stake, a new identity cannot register.
